component: Apache Arrow Gandiva scalar execution extension
notes: Version-specific Gandiva source overrides and a minimal scalar ABI. The owning runtime and query cache are zvec code under src/db/sqlengine/scalar_jit.
local_changes: Add single-row code generation and scalar parameter binding to LLVMGenerator while preserving its batch evaluator.
Expose immutable buffer binding metadata through Annotator and LLVMGenerator.
Keep the shared evaluation signature and parameter layout independent of zvec runtime headers.
